items.arabic: ذَهَبَ الظَّمَأُ وَابْتَلَّتِ العُرُوقُ, وَثَبَتَ الْأَجْرُ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ
items.title: Upon breaking fast
items.translation: The thirst is gone, the veins are moistened and the reward is confirmed, if Allah wills.

items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ بِرَحْمَتِكَ الَّتِي وَسِعَتْ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ أَنْ تَغْفِرَ لِي
items.title: Upon breaking fast
items.translation: O Allah, I ask You by Your mercy, which encompasses all things, that You forgive me.

items.arabic: إِذَا أَكَلَ أَحَدُكُمْ طَعَاماً فَلْيَقُلْ بِسْمِ اللَّهِ, فَإِنْ نَسِيَ فِي أَوَّلِهِ فَلْيَقُلْ بسمِ اللَّهِ فِي أَوَّلِهِ وَآخِرِهِ
items.title: Before eating
items.translation: With the Name of Allah.(1)(If you forgot) With the Name of Allah, in the beginning and in the end.(2)

items.arabic: مَنْ أَطْعَمَهُ اللَّهُ الطَّعَامَ فَلْيَقُلْ: اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَنَا فِيهِ وَأَطْعِمْنَا خَيْراً مِنْهُ, وَمَنْ سَقَاهُ اللَّهُ لَبَناً فَلْيَقُلْ اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَنَا فِيهِ وَزِدْنَا مِنْهُ
items.title: Before eating
items.translation: Whomever Allah has given food, should say: "O Allah, bless us in it and provide us with better than it".(1)Whomever Allah has given milk to drink, should say: "O Allah, bless us in it and give us more of it".(2)

items.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَطْعَمَنِي هَذَا, وَرَزَقَنِيهِ, مِنْ غَيْرِ حَوْلٍ مِنِّي وَلاَ قُوَّةٍ
items.title: Upon completing the meal
items.translation: Praise is to Allah Who has given me this food and sustained me with it though I was unable to do it and powerless.

items.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ حَمْداً كَثِيراً طَيِّباً مُبَارَكاً فِيهِ, غَيْرَ [مَكْفِيٍّ وَلاَ ] مُوَدَّعٍ, وَلاَ مُسْتَغْنَىً عَنْهُ رَبَّنَا
items.title: Upon completing the meal
items.translation: All praise is to Allah, praise in abundance, good and blessed. It cannot (be compensated for, nor can it) be left, nor can it be done without, our Lord.

items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَهُمْ فِيمَا رَزَقْتَهُم, وَاغْفِرْ لَهُمْ وَارْحَمْهُمْ
items.title: Of the guest for the host
items.translation: O Allah, bless them in what You have provided for them, and forgive them and have mercy on them.

items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَطْعِمْ مَنْ أَطْعَمَنِي, وَاسْقِ مَنْ سَقَانِي
items.title: To one offering a drink or to one who intended to do that
items.translation: O Allah, feed the one who has fed me and drink to the one who has given me drink.

items.arabic: أَفْطَرَ عِنْدَكُمُ الصَّائِمُونَ, وَأَكَلَ طَعَامَكُمُ الْأَبْرَارُ, وَصَلَّتْ عَلَيْكُمُ الْمَلاَئِكَةُ
items.title: When breaking fast in someone’s home
items.translation: With you, those who are fasting have broken their fast, you have fed those who are righteous, and the angels recite their prayers upon you.

items.arabic: إِذَا دُعِيَ أَحَدُكُمْ فَلْيُجِبْ, فَإِنْ كَانَ صَائِماً فَلْيُصَلِّ, وَإِنْ كَانَ مُفْطِراً فَلْيَطْعَمْ, وَمَعْنَى فَلْيُصَلِّ أَيْ فَلْيَدْعُ.
items.title: By one fasting when presented with food and does not break his fast
items.translation: When you are invited (to eat) then reply to the invitation. If you are fasting then invoke Allah's blessings (on your host), and if you are not fasting then eat.
